product: Cutroom — desktop review queue for a small video studio
audience: Editors sorting feedback and preparing the next revision across many projects
primary_task: Choose a project, filter unresolved feedback, and mark a comment addressed
scope: Resizable project list, feedback table, detail panel and local review state; media playback out of scope
stack: Preserve the existing desktop toolkit; otherwise state the selected OS and implementation approach
direction: Quiet studio tool with compact rows, clear selection, tabular metadata and one restrained accent; avoid a marketing hero or oversized cards
constraints: All frequent actions have keyboard routes
acceptance: Keyboard users can select a project, filter comments, and mark one addressed
At the declared minimum window size, actions remain reachable and panels collapse intentionally
Long file names do not cover actions or hide the only way to identify a project
Selection, hover and focus remain visually distinct
Unimplemented media and OS integrations are clearly identified
